narrative.intro: The federal contracting market totaled $203B in obligations for FY2026 to date. Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services grew 124.9% year over year. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction grew 111.3% year over year. Automobile Manufacturing grew 76.8% year over year. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction grew 75.2% year over year. Bare Printed Circuit Board Manufacturing grew 53.2% year over year. All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services grew 50.1% year over year. Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology) grew 45.4% year over year. Software Publishers grew 37.1% year over year. Telecommunications Resellers grew 28.4% year over year. Security Guards and Patrol Services grew 23.0% year over year. This ranking lists the ten fastest-growing federal contract markets by year-over-year change for the same fiscal period in FY2026 to date.

sections.heading: Which markets are expanding fastest year over year?
sections.body: Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services grew 124.9% year over year and ranks first. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction grew 111.3% year over year and ranks second. The remaining top ten are Automobile Manufacturing at 76.8%, Commercial and Institutional Building Construction at 75.2%, Bare Printed Circuit Board Manufacturing at 53.2%, All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services at 50.1%, Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology) at 45.4%, Software Publishers at 37.1%, Telecommunications Resellers at 28.4%, and Security Guards and Patrol Services at 23.0%.

sections.heading: How should contractors use a growth ranking like this?
sections.body: Contractors can treat the ranking as a snapshot of where federal obligations rose fastest for the same fiscal period year over year. The ranking does not show absolute market size, contract count, or duration of contracts. The ranking also reflects obligations for FY2026 to date, so totals are partial for the fiscal year. Contractors should pair this growth view with contract-level and agency-level data before changing business strategy.

faq.q: What are the fastest-growing federal contract markets?
faq.a: The fastest-growing federal contract markets are the ten industries listed in the ranking, led by Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services at 124.9%. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction grew 111.3%. Automobile Manufacturing grew 76.8%. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction grew 75.2%. Bare Printed Circuit Board Manufacturing grew 53.2%. All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services grew 50.1%. Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology) grew 45.4%. Software Publishers grew 37.1%. Telecommunications Resellers grew 28.4%. Security Guards and Patrol Services grew 23.0%.

faq.q: How is market growth measured here?
faq.a: Market growth is measured by year-over-year change in contract obligations for the same fiscal period. The ranking compares obligations for FY2026 to date with obligations for the same period in the prior year. The page note states that current-year totals are partial because they are fiscal year to date.
